00059 class Interceptor : public Component
00060 {
00061 public:
00062     Interceptor(Component* _owner, const bool _constrain = false) 
00063     :   owner(_owner),
00064         mouseIsOver(0),
00065         mouseIsDownOn(0),
00066         constrain(_constrain)
00067     { 
00068         setInterceptsMouseClicks(true, true);
00069     }
00070     
00071     void mouseEnter (const MouseEvent& e)
00072     {
00073         ScopedIgnoreMouse m(this);
00074         mouseMove(e);
00075     }
00076     
00077     void mouseExit (const MouseEvent& e)
00078     {
00079         ScopedIgnoreMouse m(this);
00080         
00081         if(mouseIsDownOn)
00082             mouseIsDownOn->mouseUp(e.getEventRelativeTo(mouseIsDownOn));
00083         
00084         mouseIsDownOn = 0;
00085         
00086         if(mouseIsOver)
00087             mouseIsOver->mouseExit(e.getEventRelativeTo(mouseIsOver));
00088         
00089         mouseIsOver = 0;
00090     }
00091     
00092     void mouseMove (const MouseEvent& e)
00093     {
00094         ScopedIgnoreMouse m(this);
00095         
00096         Component *comp = owner->getComponentAt(e.x, e.y);
00097         
00098         if(comp == mouseIsOver)
00099         {
00100             if(mouseIsOver)
00101                 mouseIsOver->mouseMove(e.getEventRelativeTo(mouseIsOver));
00102         }
00103         else
00104         {
00105             if(mouseIsOver)
00106                 mouseIsOver->mouseExit(e.getEventRelativeTo(mouseIsOver));
00107             
00108             mouseIsOver = comp;
00109             
00110             if(mouseIsOver)
00111                 mouseIsOver->mouseEnter(e.getEventRelativeTo(mouseIsOver));
00112         }
00113     }
00114     
00115     void mouseDown (const MouseEvent& e)
00116     {
00117         ScopedIgnoreMouse m(this);
00118         
00119         if(mouseIsOver)
00120         {
00121             mouseIsDownOn = mouseIsOver;
00122             mouseIsDownOn->mouseDown(e.getEventRelativeTo(mouseIsDownOn));
00123             
00124             lastDragX = e.x;
00125             lastDragY = e.y;
00126         }
00127     }
00128     
00129     void mouseUp (const MouseEvent& e)
00130     {
00131         ScopedIgnoreMouse m(this);
00132         
00133         if(mouseIsDownOn)
00134         {
00135             mouseIsDownOn->mouseUp(e.getEventRelativeTo(mouseIsDownOn));
00136             mouseIsDownOn = 0;
00137         }
00138     }
00139     
00140     void mouseDrag (const MouseEvent& e)
00141     {
00142         ScopedIgnoreMouse m(this);
00143         
00144         Component *comp = owner->getComponentAt(e.x, e.y);
00145         
00146         if(comp == mouseIsDownOn)
00147         {
00148             if(mouseIsDownOn)
00149                 mouseIsDownOn->mouseDrag(e.getEventRelativeTo(mouseIsDownOn));
00150         }
00151         else
00152         {
00153             int deltaX = e.x - lastDragX;
00154             int deltaY = e.y - lastDragY;
00155             double incX, incY;
00156             int steps;
00157             
00158             if(deltaX == 0)
00159             {
00160                 incX = 0;
00161                 incY = e.y > lastDragY ? 1.0 : -1.0;
00162                 steps = std::abs(deltaY);
00163             }
00164             else if(deltaY == 0)
00165             {
00166                 incX = e.x > lastDragX ? 1.0 : -1.0;
00167                 incY = 0;
00168                 steps = std::abs(deltaX);
00169             }
00170             else if(std::abs(deltaX) > std::abs(deltaY))
00171             {
00172                 incX = e.x > lastDragX ? 1.0 : -1.0;;
00173                 incY = (double)deltaY / std::abs(deltaX);
00174                 steps = std::abs(deltaX);
00175             }
00176             else
00177             {
00178                 incX = (double)deltaX / std::abs(deltaY);
00179                 incY = e.y > lastDragY ? 1.0 : -1.0;
00180                 steps = std::abs(deltaY);
00181             }
00182             
00183             double x = lastDragX;
00184             double y = lastDragY;
00185             
00186             MouseEvent eventCopy = e;
00187             
00188             while(steps--)
00189             {
00190                 eventCopy.x = constrain ? jlimit(1, getWidth()-2, (int)x) : (int)x;
00191                 eventCopy.y = constrain ? jlimit(1, getHeight()-2, (int)y) : (int)y;
00192                 
00193                 Component *comp = owner->getComponentAt(eventCopy.x, eventCopy.y);
00194                 if(comp == mouseIsDownOn)
00195                 {
00196                     if(mouseIsDownOn)
00197                         mouseIsDownOn->mouseDrag(eventCopy.getEventRelativeTo(mouseIsDownOn));
00198                 }
00199                 else
00200                 {
00201                     if(mouseIsDownOn)
00202                     {
00203                         mouseIsDownOn->mouseUp(eventCopy.getEventRelativeTo(mouseIsDownOn));
00204                         mouseIsDownOn->mouseExit(eventCopy.getEventRelativeTo(mouseIsDownOn));
00205                     }
00206                     
00207                     mouseIsDownOn = comp;
00208                     
00209                     if(mouseIsDownOn)
00210                     {
00211                         mouseIsDownOn->mouseEnter(eventCopy.getEventRelativeTo(mouseIsDownOn));
00212                         mouseIsDownOn->mouseDown(eventCopy.getEventRelativeTo(mouseIsDownOn));
00213                     }
00214                 }
00215                 
00216                 x += incX;
00217                 y += incY;
00218             }
00219         }
00220         
00221         lastDragX = e.x;
00222         lastDragY = e.y;
00223     }   
00224     
00225 private:
00226     Component* const owner;
00227     Component* mouseIsOver;
00228     Component* mouseIsDownOn;
00229     int lastDragX, lastDragY;
00230     bool constrain;
00231 };

00234 class MultiSliderBase : public Component
00235 {
00236 public:
00237     MultiSliderBase(const int numSliders = 1, 
00238                     const bool canDragAcross = true, 
00239                     const bool slidersAreHorizontal = true,
00240                     const double sliderMinimum = 0.0,
00241                     const double sliderMaximum = 1.0) throw()
00242     :   interceptor(0), horizontal(true)
00243     {
00244         setNumSliders(numSliders, canDragAcross, slidersAreHorizontal);
00245     }
00246     
00247     ~MultiSliderBase()
00248     {
00249         deleteAllChildren();
00250     }
00251     
00252     int getNumSliders() const throw() { return sliders.size(); }
00253     
00254     void setNumSliders(const int numSliders, 
00255                        const bool canDragAcross = true,
00256                        const bool slidersAreHorizontal = true,
00257                        const double sliderMinimum = 0.0,
00258                        const double sliderMaximum = 1.0) throw()
00259     {
00260         if(numSliders != sliders.size())
00261         {
00262             deleteAllChildren();
00263             sliders.clear();
00264             interceptor = 0;
00265             
00266             horizontal = slidersAreHorizontal;
00267             
00268             for(int i = 0; i < numSliders; i++)
00269             {
00270                 Slider *slider = new Slider(String("Multislider")<<i);
00271                 slider->setSliderStyle(horizontal ? Slider::LinearHorizontal : Slider::LinearVertical);
00272                 slider->setTextBoxStyle(Slider::NoTextBox, 0,0,0);
00273                 slider->setRange(sliderMinimum, sliderMaximum, 0.0);
00274                 addAndMakeVisible(slider);
00275                 sliders.add(slider);
00276             }
00277             
00278             if(canDragAcross)
00279                 addAndMakeVisible(interceptor = new Interceptor(this, true));
00280             
00281             return;
00282         }
00283         
00284         if(canDragAcross == true && interceptor == 0)
00285         {
00286             addAndMakeVisible(interceptor = new Interceptor(this, true));
00287         }
00288         else if(canDragAcross == false && interceptor != 0)
00289         {
00290             removeChildComponent(interceptor);
00291             deleteAndZero(interceptor);
00292         }
00293         
00294         if(slidersAreHorizontal != horizontal)
00295         {
00296             horizontal = slidersAreHorizontal;
00297             
00298             for(int i = 0; i < sliders.size(); i++)
00299             {
00300                 sliders[i]->setSliderStyle(horizontal ? Slider::LinearHorizontal : Slider::LinearVertical);
00301             }
00302         }
00303         
00304     }
00305     
00306     void setRange(const double newMinimum,
00307                   const double newMaximum,
00308                   const double newInterval = 0) 
00309     {
00310         for(int i = 0; i < sliders.size(); i++)
00311         {
00312             sliders[i]->setRange(newMinimum, newMaximum, newInterval);
00313         }
00314     }
00315     
00316     void resized()
00317     {
00318         if(interceptor)
00319             interceptor->setBounds(0, 0, getWidth(), getHeight());
00320         
00321         if(horizontal)
00322         {
00323             const float sliderHeight = (float)getHeight() / sliders.size();
00324             float y = 0.f;
00325             for(int i = 0; i < sliders.size(); i++)
00326             {
00327                 sliders[i]->setBounds(0, roundFloatToInt(y), getWidth(), sliderHeight);
00328                 y += sliderHeight;
00329             }
00330         }
00331         else
00332         {
00333             const float sliderWidth = (float)getWidth() / sliders.size();
00334             float x = 0.f;
00335             for(int i = 0; i < sliders.size(); i++)
00336             {
00337                 sliders[i]->setBounds(roundFloatToInt(x), 0, sliderWidth, getHeight());
00338                 x += sliderWidth;
00339             }
00340         }
00341     }
00342     
00343     Slider* getSlider(const int index) 
00344     {
00345         return sliders[index];
00346     }
00347     
00348     double getValue(const int index) 
00349     {
00350         Slider* slider = sliders[index];
00351         return slider ? slider->getValue() : 0.0;
00352     }
00353     
00354     void getValues(Array<double> &values)
00355     {
00356         values.clearQuick();
00357         values.ensureStorageAllocated(sliders.size());
00358         for(int i = 0; i < sliders.size(); i++)
00359         {
00360             values.add(sliders[i]->getValue());
00361         }
00362     }
00363     
00364     void setValue (const int index,
00365                    double newValue,
00366                    const bool sendUpdateMessage = true,
00367                    const bool sendMessageSynchronously = false)
00368     {
00369         Slider* slider = sliders[index];
00370         if(slider)
00371         {
00372             slider->setValue(newValue, sendUpdateMessage, sendMessageSynchronously);
00373         }
00374     }
00375     
00376     void setValues(Array<double> const& values,
00377                    const bool sendUpdateMessage = true,
00378                    const bool sendMessageSynchronously = false)
00379     {
00380         const int size = jmin(values.size(), sliders.size());
00381         for(int i = 0; i < size; i++)
00382         {
00383             sliders[i]->setValue(values[i], sendUpdateMessage, sendMessageSynchronously);
00384         }
00385     }
00386     
00387 protected:
00388     Array<Slider*> sliders;
00389     Interceptor *interceptor;
00390     bool horizontal;
00391 };

00405     template<class NumericalType>
00406     NumericalArray<NumericalType> getValues()
00407     {

00409         for(int i = 0; i < sliders.size(); i++)
00410         {
00411             NumericalArray<NumericalType>::roundCopy(sliders[i]->getValue(), values[i]);
00412         }

00423         for(int i = 0; i < size; i++)

00426         }
